lines.en: Iron armor clinks as I approach with authority.

lines.zh: 俯视之下，你是我的午餐。
lines.en: From up here, you're my next meal.

lines.zh: 注意了，我的剑锋锐不可挡。
lines.en: Watch out, my blade is sharp.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏在你的恐惧之上。
lines.en: Every step is on top of your fear.

lines.zh: 我只等你靠近，一剑封喉。
lines.en: I wait for you to get close, then strike.

lines.zh: 我的存在即审判，你懂的。
lines.en: My presence is judgment, you get it.

lines.zh: 只等你落网，成为我剑下的亡魂。
lines.en: Just waiting for you to fall, into my blade's grasp.

lines.zh: 我的目光所及，无一幸免。
靴跟敲在空地的石板上
lines.en: Its boot heel strikes the hollow's flagstones.
Its robe sweeps over the fortress rubble.

lines.zh: 高处不胜寒，但我无所畏惧。
lines.en: Up here, but I fear not.

lines.zh: 等待，耐心，然后是一剑封喉。
俯瞰之下，一切尽在掌握。
lines.en: From above, all is in my grasp.

lines.zh: 我等待你的愚蠢，然后是终结。
lines.en: I wait for your foolishness, then it ends.
Arrows bounce off; you must charge.

lines.zh: 我的剑已准备好，只等你送上门来。
lines.en: My sword is ready, just waiting for you.

lines.zh: 你在我的视野里，无法逃避。
lines.en: You're in my sight, nowhere to hide.
Your fear is in my eyes.

lines.zh: 俯瞰之下，你不过是蝼蚁。

lines.en: I lean on my sword, waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 我俯瞰一切，你不过是尘埃。
lines.en: I survey all, you're just dust.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我的监控中。
lines.en: Every move you make is under my watch.

lines.zh: 我在这里等待，等待你的愚蠢。
lines.en: I wait here, for your foolishness.

lines.zh: 面甲后面，我正数你的脚步。
lines.en: Behind my visor, I count your steps.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，尽入我眼。
lines.en: Your every move, in my eye.
The gaze beneath its visor pins you down.
It looks down at you from the high dais.
Its sword tip rises to point at you.

lines.zh: 痛苦噬咬，我的荣耀蒙羞！
死亡之刃，吞噬我的生命！
lines.en: Death's blade, feasting on my life!

lines.zh: 这是耻辱，我的使命受阻！
力量不再，我的判决失效！
荣耀受损，复仇之日未到！
这是耻辱，我的信念动摇！
我需静养，以恢复我之力！
我的荣耀蒙尘，但我不会倒下！
lines.en: My honor soiled, yet I fall not!

lines.zh: 战斗未尽，我的愤怒未平！
lines.en: Battle not ended, my rage unsated!

lines.zh: 我站在高处，俯瞰你的命运。
lines.en: I stand high, overseeing your fate.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃映着红石的光。
lines.en: My axe blade catches the redstone light.
You fear even to look at me.
Your end is at your feet.

lines.zh: 我手中的剑，就是你的判决。
lines.en: The sword in my hand is your sentence.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我一眼看穿。
lines.en: I see through what you're holding at a glance.
A dusk companion is most precious.

lines.zh: 你捡起了我的处刑者之剑。
lines.en: You picked up my Executioner's Sword.

lines.zh: 处刑者之剑，专为裁决而生。

lines.en: My sword, a symbol of justice.
Drop my sword, and you’ll regret it.
Your hand reaches for my sword.
Pick up my sword, and you’ll change.
My sword, the only way out.

lines.zh: 箭弹开了，只有冲刺能伤我。
lines.en: Arrows bounce off. Only a charge can hurt me.
The bell rang the moment you entered the bastion.

lines.zh: 从高台望下去，你无处可藏。
lines.en: From the high platform, you have nowhere to hide.
The arrow bounced off; you'll have to charge.
You have stepped into the execution ground.
Its blade turns and finds you.

lines.zh: 它把你看作待决的罪人
lines.en: It marks you as a convict awaiting sentence.
A cold snort escapes the heavy plate.
The execution bell has been rung.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your sword hand trembles; I can see it clearly.

lines.zh: 箭弹开了，你得冲刺才伤到我。
lines.en: Arrows bounce. Only a charge can hurt me.

lines.zh: 冲过来吧，普通刀砍不动我。
lines.en: Charge me; plain blades cannot cut me.

lines.zh: 我会让你尝到死亡的滋味。
箭弹开，只有冲刺能伤我。
lines.en: Arrows bounce off. Only a charge can hurt me.

lines.zh: 箭没用，冲刺才碰得到我。
lines.en: Arrows bounce. Only a charge reaches me.
It sets its blade across its body.

lines.zh: 护甲上的符文亮了一格
lines.en: One rune on its armor lights up.
It drops into an executioner's stance.
It waits for your charge to falter.

lines.zh: 靴子在石板上碾了一下
lines.en: Its boot grinds once on the stone.
It gives half a step and coils up.
One more step and it strikes.
The sentence is about to fall.
Swing the sword, cold light flashes!
Cut down all, only fear remains.
Eye of the abyss, witnesses death.
It sweeps its sword at your legs.
The flat of the blade slams your armor.
It charges you behind the leveled blade.
One cut splits the floor open.
It grabs you by the collar.
The blade tip rests on your throat.
It shoves you into the stone wall.

lines.zh: 斩击声盖住了你的喘息
lines.en: The cut drowns out your breathing.
Its sword has never spared anyone.
Under the bastion, my sword stands upright.

lines.zh: 灵魂已被锁定，无法逃脱！

lines.en: The door to the fortress hollow opens.
An iron figure rises on the dais.
The executioner walks down the steps, sword in hand.

lines.zh: 痛苦噬咬，我的荣耀蒙羞，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Honor wounded by this pain! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 坠落，火焰焚毁我的牢笼！
箭矢贯穿，我的守护崩溃！
魔法术士，你的力量击溃我！
雷电击中，我的审判失灵！
深渊吞噬，我的灵魂消散！
